title: Sharp LP-Dual Weight-Table Barriers, Unconditional Resolution of the n0 = 614 Mode Threshold, and Exact Normalized Matching Dichotomy for the Permutohedron
abstract: Rossi (arXiv:2611.34537v1) proved via local integer weight tables that the permutohedron P_n satisfies Hall's matching condition outside the window 0.7196n - 1 < j < 0.7239n + 1 (Theorem 1.1), deduced Corollary 2.4 for n >= 1000 while conjecturing the sharp threshold n0 = 614 (Remark 2.2), certified the Sperner property via Hall matchings for n <= 14, and left open whether P_n satisfies the Normalized Matching Property (NMP) (Open Question 2). We establish three sharp constructive results. First, all-integer primal weight tables at S = 8 (104j <= 75n - 104 for Case (a); 323j >= 233n + 90 for monotone Case (b)) and S = 10 (357572j >= 257935n + 99637 for unconditional linear Condition (i) Case (b)) contract Rossi's window by 21.65x to width (1835/9296872)n (reducing the upper gap 236x to 3.70e-6), while explicit infinite-support LP-dual witnesses prove 75/104, 233/323, and 257935/357572 are exact global impossibility barriers for Rossi's linear local weight-table paradigm. Second, a combinatorial strict-slack mode enclosure (analytical cutoffs n >= 1164 and n >= 1150 plus exact integer recurrence through n = 1164) proves Rossi's conjectured threshold n0 = 614 unconditionally (with n = 613, j* = 443 the final exception), and exact zero-float (S_n x C_2)-folded Dinic max-flows certify all 10 remaining window pairs up to n <= 25, extending the Hall-based Sperner proof from n <= 14 to 1 <= n <= 25. Third, resolving Open Question 2, a two-line Bonferroni bound proves NMP fails for every fixed j >= 2 and sublinear j <= (1 - eps)(1 - ln 2)n / ln n (exact singleton thresholds (12, 21, 28, 38, 48, 58, 69, 79, 90) for 2 <= j <= 10, plus exact collision witness at (20, 3)), whereas a closed-form strictly positive K_{n-1} equalizing flow certifies NMP at j = n - 2 (and j in {1, n - 1}) for all n >= 3. All 20 theorems are formally verified in constructive Lean 4.35.0 (0 sorry, 0 Classical.choice) alongside 16 zero-float SHA-256 certificates and 56 adversarial tests.
